SiteContent.title: SiteContent
SiteContent.description: Public CMS state and authorized staff email allowlist for Naseem Al-Ataa Trading Company.

payloadJson.description: Serialized CMS state (categories, products, company info, theme, pages, staff roles).

authorizedEmails.description: Bounded allowlist of active staff and admin Google emails (max 50).

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin or staff member who published the update.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

addedBy.description: UID of the super admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was created.

SiteMedia.title: SiteMedia
SiteMedia.description: High-resolution media asset (slider banner, product photo, or icon) stored separately to keep SiteContent lightweight.

mediaId.description: Deterministic ID of the media asset.

dataUrl.description: Base64 data URL of the image.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin or staff member who uploaded the asset.

/site_content/{docId}.description: Publicly readable website CMS state document (docId = 'main') updated by authorized admins and staff.

/site_media/{mediaId}.description: Publicly readable high-resolution images and banners uploaded by authorized admins and staff.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Collection of authorized super admin UIDs.
